apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk, sideload it
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it

## What's new
- libretro: say what ARMSX2_USE_BUNDLED_SHADERC is actually doing
- libretro: rumble through the frontend, since the core owns no motors
- libretro: link shaderc and stub the JNI calls on the Android core
- libretro: build the Android core without Oboe
- libretro: build the core where the GL renderer and adrenotools are not
- libretro: let the OS answer metadata the host cannot, and stop paying twice
- libretro: take the VFS version the frontend accepted, not the one it claims
- cmake: correct the Android branch comment in detect_operating_system
- cmake: append sharpyuv rather than overwrite webp's link interface
- libretro: drop the duplicate ARMSX2_LIBRETRO define
- Libretro: review fixes - exact file sizes, host mkdir, VFS version, GL flavour
- Libretro: review fixes - Vulkan include order, Android page size, no x86_64 job
- Libretro: build the core for Android (arm64-v8a)
- Libretro: build the core for macOS (arm64)
- Libretro: fix the buildbot Linux jobs
- Libretro: let the core render through the frontend's GL context
- Libretro: use the frontend's virtual file system

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20260905...90e0c882075a6bce75437ccd6d90ecac7969b206
